# Ordinary-decoration direct-base movable limits

These 60 cases use the unchanged pinned MathJax 3.2.2 assets from D2 v0.8.1. The generator observes kind, text, explicit attributes, own properties and ordered children before unchanged output rendering and hashes the complete SVG. It retains six required primary error outputs. The fixture is the exact generator output, including all primary fields; comparison projections do not claim inherited/default/flag equality.

The original D072 accepted baseline was `69ae099022c270469016a6a83f9f9ae13d98e320`. The production change invokes the already accepted direct-base `checkMovableLimits` helper for ordinary decorations. It leaves brace normalization, bar's Accent dispatch, annotation ownership and decoration `subsupOK` permission unchanged. It does not recursively change grouped or scripted descendants.

Four formerly wrong inline formulas now match the complete primary SVG: overline and overrightarrow on sum, overline on product, and overline on mathop. Their display outputs were already identical; all eight compiler trees now have the source direct-base fields. All other 56 SVGs remain byte-identical to the accepted baseline. The original D072 gate had 36 raw-primary SVGs, 8 raw explicit projections and 6 raw own-property projections.

The boundaries file is exact and baseline-bound. Twenty-two existing false under-decoration script errors remain pending the separate D071 permission fix, while the two previously qualified scripted-overline cases now match raw primary SVG after D073. The 22 remaining complete error SVG/tree records must stay exactly equal to the accepted baseline and are not parity passes. Of the current 38 raw-SVG cases, 32 retain precisely listed per-node attribute/property differences from that same baseline; every other projected field remains primary. The one source-matching family upgrade is overline-mathop-inline at child path [0,0,0], accepted msup to primary/candidate mover. Its remaining accent/subsupOK maps are the exact accepted maps, bound with both node kinds. No generic field omission, wrapper removal or output normalization is permitted.

Primary source: MathJax `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`, `ParseUtil.underOver` 375–393 / `checkMovableLimits` 400–405; `BaseMethods.UnderOver` 611–616 and `BaseMappings` 512–523. D073 now implements the separate embellished under/over base row; see `scripted_decoration_README.md`. Its two upgraded cases use the untouched primary fixture and exact unchanged baseline metadata maps aligned across that new row. The other 58 D072 SVGs and complete captured compiler trees remain byte-identical to accepted D072. New related controls must reveal any changed-but-wrong behavior rather than broadening these exceptions.

The actual caller controls cover six line/arrow commands with sum, product, mathop, integral and grouped sum. The exact shared-helper identity controls preserve base/child/parent pointers, complete own maps and repeat behavior; inherited truthiness, contextual dictionary/form and nonrecursive controls remain required. The original D072 old-production overlay failed the eight public-tree cases and eighteen caller cases, while the other 87 focused subtests passed. Focused inherited accent/arrow/horizontal/stack and Overunderset reference suites are also required before full gates.
